proposed_remediation_batches.scope: Verify actual scheduler-to-HTTP/Edge/business/provider outcomes, automatic rate/history integrity, queue concurrency/retry/terminal history and egress. Establish scope-labelled metrics/budgets, accountable alert/support receipt and private evidence handling. Complete protected database/file/config/key/offsite coverage and realistic fresh isolated recovery; exercise compatible containment/rollback.
proposed_remediation_batches.exit_evidence: Controlled successful/failing/retry jobs with correct recipients/destinations and history; actual alert/review/support operation; complete protected component artifacts and independent recovery; measured accepted RPO/RTO and compatible operator stop/resume/rollback checks.
proposed_remediation_batches.dependencies: Accepted OP-D02–OP-D05, recoverable operators/recipients/queues, actual installed definitions and safe approved exercise scopes. Keep the successful prior loopback recovery target stopped; Google offsite deferral is not completed independent protection.

proposed_remediation_batches.title: Provider identity, linking, callbacks and actual email rendering/delivery
proposed_remediation_batches.scope: Implement agreed Google/Apple/web/PWA/native identity flows and provider-purpose-aware mail integration where required. Verify actual Go/Supabase templates and contextual escaping, trusted metadata/origins, collisions/linking/invite/recovery outcomes and controlled inbox delivery.
proposed_remediation_batches.exit_evidence: Controlled provider login/cancel/error, existing-identity/invitation collision/linking and supported callbacks; actual template rendering and inbox receipts; expiry/replay/mismatched identity/unsafe URL denials.
proposed_remediation_batches.dependencies: Accepted provider/client/domain/audience decisions, functioning factual notices and owner-controlled identities/inboxes. No automatic provider activation or message dispatch follows from this handoff.

proposed_remediation_batches.title: Authoritative commerce, entitlements and lifecycle
proposed_remediation_batches.scope: Choose channel/catalogue/plan/seat mapping and implement actual server provider receipt/signature/webhook verification, durable idempotent ownership/ledger/concurrency controls, entitlement expiry/refund/restore and cross-channel consistency.
proposed_remediation_batches.exit_evidence: Actual sandbox purchase/receipt/restore/refund/expiry/replay/concurrent ownership outcomes with server-authoritative entitlements; existing manual web/Business flows remain correct.
proposed_remediation_batches.dependencies: Applicable account/provider/product decisions, exact server/storage/permissions and sandbox identities. No real charges, automatic account creation or store product publication is authorized by the plan.

proposed_remediation_batches.title: Final native/device/PWA quality and publisher/store evidence
proposed_remediation_batches.scope: Reconcile the actual owner-local native project/signing identity without reset; obtain accepted build tools and complete artifacts, secure session/backup and callback/push lifecycle, actual SDK/privacy manifests, representative device/browser/accessibility/performance and account-specific store/beta/reviewer/declaration evidence.
proposed_remediation_batches.exit_evidence: Final artifact/identity/signing/dependency/SDK inspection and actual device install/Auth/backup/account-switch/push/permission/privacy/PWA checks; measured accepted budgets; truthful final notices/store declarations/listings and required account-specific testing.
proposed_remediation_batches.dependencies: Earlier implementation and privacy/commerce/identity decisions, actual device/build/account prerequisites and explicit artifact scope. APK update remains deferred until that later concrete authorized work.

proposed_remediation_batches.title: Fresh full final audit and accountable release disposition
proposed_remediation_batches.scope: After accepted remediation, rediscover the current tests/scripts, run appropriate full current suites/CI and direct hosted/device/provider/recovery/store requirements against the final exact source, installations and artifacts. Reconcile all original coverage/findings/actions and preserved failures; prepare a concrete reviewable release/rollback/incident package.
proposed_remediation_batches.exit_evidence: All 123 original coverage rows and 20 definitions have dated exact-scope accepted results or explicit accountable residual disposition; required failures/blockers resolved, final full fresh audit completed, release/rollback/recovery ownership and accepted artifacts documented.
proposed_remediation_batches.dependencies: Final accepted implementation/deployments/artifacts and required earlier evidence. Old offline PASS or checkpoint closure is not a fresh final audit or publishing authority.

original_finding_handoff_mapping.title: Public policies and support notices
original_finding_handoff_mapping.original_action: Resolve actual operator/age/territory/data/retention facts, then publish factual privacy/terms/support notices and functioning links.
original_finding_handoff_mapping.original_recheck: Public URLs return the intended notices; logged-in/signup/native/store surfaces link to the same factual versions; processor/retention facts match actual behavior.

original_finding_handoff_mapping.title: Account deletion and shared ownership
original_finding_handoff_mapping.original_action: Define ownership transfer, shared-record retention and personal-data removal, then implement authenticated deletion with provider/Storage cleanup.
original_finding_handoff_mapping.original_recheck: Owned synthetic users complete deletion; unauthorized/replayed requests fail; retained shared records and removed personal files/tokens follow the agreed rules.

original_finding_handoff_mapping.title: Native subscriptions and billing
original_finding_handoff_mapping.original_action: Decide channel/plan/seat mapping, then implement server verification, idempotent entitlement updates, refunds/restore and web/native consistency.
original_finding_handoff_mapping.original_recheck: Actual sandbox purchases, restore/refund/expiry/replay and cross-channel seat/plan cases match server-authoritative entitlement outcomes.

original_finding_handoff_mapping.title: Google/Apple login and linking
original_finding_handoff_mapping.original_action: Design supported providers/callbacks/linking and invitation collisions; implement only the agreed flows and correct purpose-aware emails.
original_finding_handoff_mapping.original_recheck: Controlled web/PWA/native sign-in, cancellation, mismatched identity, existing-account linking and invitation collision cases pass with exact supported callbacks.

original_finding_handoff_mapping.title: Native release and store readiness
original_finding_handoff_mapping.original_action: Preserve signing/app identity, establish native/tool/store prerequisites and build/review actual artifacts on accepted environments.
original_finding_handoff_mapping.original_recheck: SDK/toolchain, complete merged manifest, permissions/signing, physical-device behavior and required store-account testing evidenced for the final release.

original_finding_handoff_mapping.title: Native dependency and asset build
original_finding_handoff_mapping.original_action: Reconcile original local edits without reset; maintain compatible pins and failure-preserving complete asset packaging, then compile and inspect actual native output.
original_finding_handoff_mapping.original_recheck: Clean locked install/consumer/asset checks repeat; packaging failure preserves old assets; final native artifacts contain complete latest pages/bridge and pass device smoke checks.

original_finding_handoff_mapping.title: Browser security headers
original_finding_handoff_mapping.original_action: Add compatible serving-layer headers/CSP in isolation, check required CDN/Auth/assets, then verify actual served header/routes and native-origin compatibility.
original_finding_handoff_mapping.original_recheck: Header/CSP checks on public/app/assets and redirects; ordinary signup, invitation, push, downloads and supported native origins still work; deliberate injection/frame checks behave as intended.

original_finding_handoff_mapping.title: Admin MFA, password and Auth UX
original_finding_handoff_mapping.original_action: Coordinate server-enforced Admin step-up with UI, password/recovery/setup behavior, rates/session policy and unconfirmed-email guidance. Verify infrastructure access through actual sign-in paths in 1.1.
original_finding_handoff_mapping.original_recheck: Direct privileged API denies inadequate assurance; authorized step-up works; confirmation/setup cannot be bypassed; normal recovery, password changes, expiry and rate/failure cases pass.

original_finding_handoff_mapping.title: Contact/enquiry abuse control
original_finding_handoff_mapping.original_action: Define server-authoritative submission/challenge/quota and input policy, retain ordinary enquiries and audit safe failure behavior.
original_finding_handoff_mapping.original_recheck: Normal controlled submissions succeed; forged/missing challenge, malformed/oversized data and repeated abusive submissions are denied without exposing private enquiries.

original_finding_handoff_mapping.title: Native origins and callbacks
original_finding_handoff_mapping.original_action: Inventory actual deployed/native origins, retain verified identity/authorization and support explicit required callbacks rather than broad origin relaxation.
original_finding_handoff_mapping.original_recheck: Supported web/PWA/native callbacks succeed; unrelated origins, edited identity/request links and expired/revoked links fail with safe routing.

original_finding_handoff_mapping.title: Native notifications
original_finding_handoff_mapping.original_action: Select and implement/reconcile native transport as required; bind tokens to actual users/devices and define private notification content.
original_finding_handoff_mapping.original_recheck: Closed/minimized delivery on actual devices, sign-out/account-switch token cleanup, permission revocation, route handling and lock-screen privacy checks pass.

original_finding_handoff_mapping.title: Web Push outbound destinations
original_finding_handoff_mapping.original_action: Assess actual endpoint provider rules and implement justified egress/destination controls with compatibility and failure/retry handling.
original_finding_handoff_mapping.original_recheck: Controlled private-network/malformed/redirect/rebinding cases are blocked where applicable; legitimate provider endpoints still deliver and retries do not cause duplicate/unsafe requests.

original_finding_handoff_mapping.title: Uploads and downloads
original_finding_handoff_mapping.original_action: Add justified server content/size/quota validation, safe storage/download treatment and ownership authorization; preserve accepted file types.
original_finding_handoff_mapping.original_recheck: MIME/signature mismatch, malformed/oversized/unauthorized uploads/downloads denied; valid owned files render/share safely with correct access and size behavior.

original_finding_handoff_mapping.title: Native sessions and device/cloud backup
original_finding_handoff_mapping.original_action: Inspect full merged artifact/session storage; define secure sensitive storage and cloud/device-transfer exclusions, expiry and account-switch handling.
original_finding_handoff_mapping.original_recheck: Artifact/storage inspection and device backup/restore/transfer tests exclude sensitive session material; expiry/sign-out/switch/resume behavior preserves correct identity and workspace.

original_finding_handoff_mapping.title: Supabase grants, tenant and currency workflows
original_finding_handoff_mapping.original_action: Review actual function authorization without blanket revokes; verify legitimate currency/payment/settings/scheduler paths and direct allowed/denied tenant/file/event behavior in isolation. Reconcile current redirects/APP_ORIGIN.
original_finding_handoff_mapping.original_recheck: Real controlled JWT callers exercise own/other/removed users, public/server/protected functions, files/exports/realtime; authorized currency writes and scheduler preserve historical integrity; replay/tampering denied.

original_finding_handoff_mapping.title: Database and uploaded-file recovery
original_finding_handoff_mapping.original_action: Establish protected external database plus file/configuration coverage, retention/completeness checks and isolated recovery evidence with explicit targets.
original_finding_handoff_mapping.original_recheck: Owner-held artifacts cover selected data/roles/files/config dependencies; failure/incomplete-run detection works; isolated restore with integrity/scope checks and realistic completeness limits is documented.

original_finding_handoff_mapping.title: Apple privacy manifests and SDKs
original_finding_handoff_mapping.original_action: Inventory actual SDK data/required reasons; include and validate correct manifests/signatures in the final iOS archive.
original_finding_handoff_mapping.original_recheck: Final archive/privacy report and SDK/reason declarations match shipped APIs/data use; device/build/store validation completed for that artifact.

original_finding_handoff_mapping.title: Repository/tool/dependency protection
original_finding_handoff_mapping.original_action: Reconcile tooling/deployment provenance, pin justified build tools, review repo access/protection and perform appropriate dependency/history/artifact scans without exposing secrets.
original_finding_handoff_mapping.original_recheck: Actual tool versions/locked installs/CI provenance recorded; relevant scans and protection/access checks complete; final native/web/Edge artifacts contain no unauthorized secrets/development assets.

original_finding_handoff_mapping.title: Staging, monitoring and incident operations
original_finding_handoff_mapping.original_action: Establish isolated synthetic environment, read-only deployed/cron inventory, actual alert/support routing, owner/budget/incident/export/restore runbooks and serving-layer mapping.
original_finding_handoff_mapping.original_recheck: Staging cannot use production data/config or dispatch production messages; failed job/export/outage triggers verified routing; operator can follow runbooks; deployed version/schedule/usage ownership reconciled.

original_finding_handoff_mapping.title: Collection, privacy and disclosures
original_finding_handoff_mapping.original_action: Inventory actual collected data and processors/SDKs, purpose/retention/sharing and age/operator/territory decisions; align notices and store declarations with actual implementation.
original_finding_handoff_mapping.original_recheck: Inventory matches actual data flows/SDKs and retention/deletion; public notices, consent where applicable and store Data safety/App Privacy declarations reflect the final worldwide-supported release.
